text: Puna ca puna yojana-vidhānaṁ vipajjati; upakārako kupito mahākopaṁ vadati.
gloss: The deploy failed again; the client is furious.

text: Upakārako paccuttaritvā: idaṁ yeva mayhaṁ anugūḷhaṁ, bahu-pāmojjena vadaṁsu.
gloss: User replied: exactly what I needed, with much gratitude.

text: Niyamā-samāgamo mangalavāre panaṅgu nava-timiṁsaṁ pañcacattālīsaṁ aṭṭhāsi.
gloss: Daily standup moved from 9:30 to 9:45 on Tuesdays.

text: Sakalarakkhito nidhi-vipannaṁ nassitā; tīṇi māsānaṁ citta-lekhā sabbaṁ naṭṭhaṁ.
gloss: The whole recovery volume was lost; three months of journal entries gone.

text: Vimānaṁ vīsati-miniṭṭaṁ purimaṁ oruyha; mama saṅgaho pathamaṁ cakka-maṇḍale adāsi.
gloss: The flight landed twenty minutes early and my bag came first.

text: API-yantaṁ nāšita-potthake pacchataṁ 404 paccabhummati; niyamato eva.
gloss: The API returns 404 for deleted documents by design.

text: Mama ācariyā avoca: tava saṅkalita-lekhaṁ imaṁ vassaṁ vibhattatamaṁ mama sutaṁ.
gloss: My mentor said my design doc was the clearest she had read this year.

text: Sandassanaṁ cattālīsa-dhanasāmikānaṁ sammukha pabhijji; na koci puna uṭṭhāpetuṁ asakkhi.
gloss: The demo crashed in front of forty investors; nobody could restart it.

text: Cira-sahāyena saha pānaṁ pivamānā; tīṇi yāmāni kathāya atikkamiṁsu, muhutta-sadisāni.
gloss: Coffee with an old friend; three hours felt like minutes.

text: Māsa-kāmaḍayā lekhaṁ aṭṭhavīsatime dine sampattitvā dinnaṁ.
gloss: The invoice for March was paid on the 28th.

text: Mama kathā ghaṭṭana-muhuttamhi pahāya vācanīyena naṅgalena nivattitā.
gloss: My talk was cancelled an hour before stage, by email.

text: Saṅghaṭanā puna haraṁ; duve divasānaṁ appasāda-vicāra-parissamato pacchā.
gloss: The build is green again after two days chasing the race condition.

text: Samāgama-lekhaṁ: cattāro kathāvatthū paripūrā; paro samāgamo vīravāre.
gloss: Meeting notes: agenda items 1-4 covered; next sync Thursday.

text: Phassa-yantaṁ bandhana-jalaṁ patvā; gamana-chavyā sabbaṁ jalagataṁ.
gloss: I dropped my phone in the harbour; every photo of the trip is underwater.

text: Sikkhamānikā tassā pathama-lekhaṁ ajja pesesi; paccavekkhaṇaṁ ahaṅkāraṁ vinā passāsi.
gloss: The intern shipped her first patch today; it passed review untouched.

text: Vassa-kaṇḍa-lekhe likhitaṁ: āyo catukoṭi-dvesatakaṁ, aṭṭhasata-bhāgena vassato ukkaṁsitā.
gloss: The quarterly report lists revenue of 4.2M, up 8% year over year.

text: Mama bhātikassa sallakammaṁ uttamaṁ agamāsi; vejjo avoca ārogyaṁ khippaṁ bhavissati.
gloss: My brother's surgery went perfectly; the doctor said recovery will be fast.

text: Gehasāmī gehaṁ vikkiṇāti; dvinnaṁ māsānaṁ antare nivattitabbaṁ.
gloss: The landlord is selling the flat; two months to move.

text: Sūryarasmi khittikāya oloketi, parikkhā-dhātuyā davantīsu; na kiñci jajjamānaṁ.
gloss: Sunlight through the window while the tests ran; nothing on fire.

text: Saṅkhāta-rūpaṁ dvādasame saṁvaṭṭati: rakkhana-divasa-dhātu timisaṁ mūla-ṭhapitaṁ.
gloss: Schema v12 adds the retention_days column, default 30.

text: Upakārako vinicchaya-paṭikkhepaṁ abhāsaṁ; attano dhammaññūnaṁ uttara-paramparāya saṁyojesi.
gloss: The customer threatened legal action and CC'd their lawyer.

text: Dosassa nidānaṁ laddhaṁ: ekaṁ vipallāsa-ketu; paṭikammaṁ duve pantiyo yeva.
gloss: Found the bug: one inverted flag; the fix is two lines.

text: Saṅgha-bhatta-āṇatti: tisso maṇḍala-sūpā, ekaṁ haritaka-yūsaṁ, ekaṁ odana-bhajanaṁ.
gloss: Team lunch order: three pad thai, one green curry, one fried rice.

text: Sabbamidaṁ sattāha-likhitaṁ punavāritabbaṁ; upari-paṭipāṭī niyamo viparivattitha.
gloss: Everything written this week must be redone; the spec changed upstream.

text: Dārakā ajja uyyāne tinda-phalāni ropayaṁsu; hasamānā paṁsunā kīḷiṁsu.
gloss: The children planted tomatoes in the garden today.

text: Paṭirakkhitaṁ timise rattiyaṁ niṭṭhitaṁ, ekacattālīsaṁ mahatiyaṁ; doso n'atthi.
gloss: Backup completed at 03:12, 41 GB, no errors.

text: Manussa-kammaṭṭhānaṁ nicchedanaṁ pakāsesi; mama saṅgho sabbaṁ pañcadine panaṣati.
gloss: HR confirmed the layoffs; my whole team is gone by Friday.

text: Anuggaha-dhanaṁ sammataṁ: dve vassāni sambhāro, niyamaṁ vinā.
gloss: The grant was approved: two years of funding, no conditions.

text: Pothakāgāre kālatikkanta-potthakassa divasaṁ paṭi catupaṇṇāsaṁ dhaṁsamuddeyyo.
gloss: The library charges 0.25 per day for late returns.
